exp.desc:
- Fatigue life calculation for a planetary gearbox
- Method adopted for two further ranges

cl.p1: my master’s dissertation, written with a wind turbine supplier, was a fatigue life calculation for a planetary gearbox under variable loads. The method I developed is now used by the team for two further product ranges.
cl.p2: I studied mechanical engineering with a focus on design and drivetrains, and I am confident with 3D CAD and finite element analysis. Your marine propulsion gearboxes are exactly the field I want to go deeper into.

cl.p1: forty special-purpose machines in eight years, from specification to customer acceptance: that is my record at a builder of assembly systems. I have learned that the best design is the one a fitter can build without asking a question.
cl.p2: I am an incorporated engineer, work daily with 3D CAD and data management, and for the last two years I have technically led a team of three designers. Your work for the medical sector, with its strict requirements, is what draws me.
